payload.reason: The evidence provides a comprehensive overview of various types of offensive content explored in research, including hate speech, cyberbullying, aggression, insults, threats, and profanity.

claims.text: Different kinds of offensive content include hate speech, cyberbullying, aggression, insults, threats, and profanity.
Offensive content can be targeted at individuals or groups, and can also include non-targeted insults and threats.
The OLID dataset categorizes offensive language into profanity, insult, and abuse.
